spanish: El nativo en hijos de Israel y al peregrino el peregrinante en medio de ellos, torá una será a ustedes al hacedor por error.

findings.issue: torá leaves the common noun תּוֹרָה (H8451, feminine singular absolute, not a proper name) untranslated; a common noun must be Spanish.
Uncertain: peregrino and peregrinante commonly mean pilgrim; גר and the qal participle of גור license a sojourner and sojourning.

notes: Other tokens match in number, person, and participants; ustedes is licensed 2pl.
